Title: LinkedIn Learning and Learnster Deep Integration Guide

Blocks.Section: LinkedIn Learning and Learnster Deep Integration Guide
Blocks.Text: As a Learnster admin, you can integrate LinkedIn Learning with Learnster to import English-language courses, enable single sign-on (SSO), and receive course completion data through the Experience API (xAPI), a standard for sharing learning activity between systems. Setup requires admin access to both LinkedIn Learning and Learnster.
Learners can use their organization’s credentials to access LinkedIn Learning through SAML single sign-on (SSO). This reduces the need to manage a separate set of sign-in credentials.

As a Learnster admin, you can select and import the LinkedIn Learning courses you want to make available in Learnster. Learnster retrieves catalog metadata through LinkedIn Learning content APIs, so you don’t need to manually upload content packages.
The integration supports English-language courses only. Course titles and descriptions are indexed to help learners find courses through keyword searches.

LinkedIn Learning records learners’ activity for content viewed on its platform in usage reports available in the LinkedIn Learning admin interface. When a learner completes a LinkedIn Learning course, LinkedIn Learning sends their course completion data to Learnster through xAPI.
As an admin, you can view learners’ course completions in both LinkedIn Learning and Learnster, helping you track LinkedIn Learning completions alongside other training in Learnster.
Important

Ensure each learner’s work email address in LinkedIn Learning matches their email address in Learnster. When configuring xAPI reporting, select Email as the User Type so Learnster can associate course completions with the correct learner.
To set up the integration, you need:

An active Learnster LMS instance with admin access.
An active LinkedIn Learning account with admin access.

LinkedIn Learning recommends SAML SSO for enterprise learning platform integrations. If your organization uses an identity provider such as Azure AD, Okta, or Active Directory Federation Services (AD FS), you can configure it to authenticate learners accessing LinkedIn Learning.
To configure SAML SSO, share the LinkedIn Learning SSO Implementation Guide with your organization’s IT team.

Blocks.Section: Step 2: Generate Content API credentials in LinkedIn Learning
SectionPath: Step 2: Generate Content API credentials in LinkedIn Learning
Blocks.Text: Generate Content API credentials in LinkedIn Learning admin settings so Learnster can retrieve LinkedIn Learning catalog metadata.

Blocks.Section: Step 2: Generate Content API credentials in LinkedIn Learning
SectionPath: Step 2: Generate Content API credentials in LinkedIn Learning
Blocks.Text:
After you log in, if you are not already in the Admin screen, select Go to Admin, then click Me > Integrate.

From the side navigation menu, select Access content and reports via API and expand Generate LinkedIn Learning REST API Application.

Click Add application.


In the Add LinkedIn Learning API application screen, provide the name of your learning platform (e.g., "Learnster Courses Export") as the application name.

Provide a short description of the integration use case in the application description field. For example, "Learnster courses export".

Under Choose keys, there are two checkboxes – Content and Report. Select Content.

Click Next and accept the Terms and Conditions.

Save the Client ID and Client Secret values. You will use these values in Step 3.

Blocks.Section: Step 2: Generate Content API credentials in LinkedIn Learning
SectionPath: Step 2: Generate Content API credentials in LinkedIn Learning
Blocks.Text: Important

Blocks.Section: Step 2: Generate Content API credentials in LinkedIn Learning
SectionPath: Step 2: Generate Content API credentials in LinkedIn Learning
Blocks.Text: The client secret is displayed only once. Store it securely and do not share it outside your organization.

Blocks.Section: Step 3: Configure LinkedIn Learning in Learnster
SectionPath: Step 3: Configure LinkedIn Learning in Learnster
Blocks.Text: Enable the LinkedIn Learning integration in Learnster and obtain the credentials needed to configure xAPI reporting.

Blocks.Section: Step 3: Configure LinkedIn Learning in Learnster
SectionPath: Step 3: Configure LinkedIn Learning in Learnster
Blocks.Text: To complete the configuration with Learnster, you need the following information:

Blocks.Section: Step 3: Configure LinkedIn Learning in Learnster
SectionPath: Step 3: Configure LinkedIn Learning in Learnster
Blocks.Text:
Client ID
Client Secret

Blocks.Section: Step 3: Configure LinkedIn Learning in Learnster
SectionPath: Step 3: Configure LinkedIn Learning in Learnster
Blocks.Text:
Go to Learnster Studio and navigate to Settings > Integrations > LinkedIn to access the setup interface.

Add the credentials you saved from LinkedIn Learning, then enable the integration by switching the Credentials enabled toggle ON.

Switch the xAPI Integration toggle ON.


Retrieve the following values from the Learnster configuration page (these are used when you return to LinkedIn Learning to complete the xAPI reporting configuration):

OAuth Server URL
Tenant Server URL
Client ID
Client Secret
Scope

Blocks.Section: Step 4: Configure xAPI reporting in LinkedIn Learning
SectionPath: Step 4: Configure xAPI reporting in LinkedIn Learning
Blocks.Text: Use the reporting credentials obtained from Learnster to configure xAPI reporting in LinkedIn Learning:

Blocks.Section: Step 4: Configure xAPI reporting in LinkedIn Learning
SectionPath: Step 4: Configure xAPI reporting in LinkedIn Learning
Blocks.Text:
After you log in, if you are not already in the Admin screen, click Go to Admin, then select Me > Integrate.

From the side navigation menu, select Configure content push and reporting integrations.

Expand the Configure xAPI section.

Click Add integration.


In the Integration name field, enter a name such as "Learnster Reporting".

In the User Type drop down, select Email. This value must match the learner’s email address in Learnster.

Copy and paste the following items provided by Learnster into LinkedIn Learning:

OAuth Server URL
Tenant Server URL
Client ID
Client Secret
Scope



Under Confirm which data you want to share for this integration, select Course completions and Course progress.

Click Enable.

Blocks.Section: Step 4: Configure xAPI reporting in LinkedIn Learning
SectionPath: Step 4: Configure xAPI reporting in LinkedIn Learning
Blocks.Text: You have now successfully enabled the Learnster xAPI connection in LinkedIn Learning.
